title: Fertilisation and Pregnancy
welcome_lead: Trace how sperm meets egg, and how a tiny cell grows into a baby.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on fertilisation and pregnancy outline.
final_note: You now know the main steps from fertilisation to birth at a simple level.

walkthroughs.body_html: During fertilisation, a sperm and egg fuse to form one new cell. This happens in the woman's reproductive system.
The cell divides many times. The growing embryo implants in the uterus. After about 9 weeks it is called a foetus.
The placenta takes food and oxygen from the mother's blood. The umbilical cord carries them to the baby and returns waste back to the mother.
